name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Onboarding & Success | Multi-Stakeholder Projects from Signed Contract to Live
summary: Onboarding and customer success lead who takes a customer from signed contract to live and stays on the account after. Managed up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets, and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye by watching performance data and following up when a partner fell behind. Keeps many-stakeholder projects organized and visible, hands off cleanly between teams, and fixes the process instead of working around it. Works daily in Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Excel.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run client onboarding end to end, from kickoff and requirements through data collection, configuration, testing, training, and handoff.
Coordinate owners and staff on each project, setting clear expectations about what the client's team needs to deliver.
Document every timeline, deliverable, and status in Notion and the CRM so each project's state is current and visible.
Build reusable templates and automated workflows that cut repeat work across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent across implementations to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded 15-20 reseller partners and ensured each partner's end customers were configured on Birdeye's listings-syndication solution, retaining all but one partner (~94%).
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Built automated product-training sequences and communication workflows that helped partners roll the product out to their own customers.
Shared structured onboarding feedback with Product and Engineering; tracked all activity in Salesforce.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed up to ~25 concurrent onboardings and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Set up third-party shipping integrations for e-commerce clients launching online storefronts alongside their physical retail locations.
Ran onboarding calls as primary customer contact, launching simple builds on the first call and scoping multi-session production plans for complex ones.
Led and trained onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly sessions and 1:1 coaching, and defined the Salesforce fields used across onboarding workflows.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting technical challenges during setup and escalating risk early.
